composition.motif: Ben Mua leitmotif: D major pentatonic question phrase hanging on scale degree 2; the full flute tail stays reserved for the resolve stinger and rift_finale
composition.structure: Additive intensity layer over thanh_lac (16 bars @ 96 bpm): soft drum on the bar line and on beat 2 (the two-beat market pulse; the base has no drums at all) and a low pluck echo of the motif head on bars 4 and 13 (bars where the base has no melody; the arpeggio is texture, not melody). The base has pads on every bar, a bell of the chord tonic on every bar line, bass on all four beats, pluck arpeggios on every bar plus a second off-beat pluck voice an octave down, flute motif at bars 0/8, a low-pluck tail at bar 12 and shaker on every offbeat; this layer adds the pulse the market arrangement withholds. No bells, no shaker, no bass fill, no pad, no flute. -25 LUFS target; combined base+layer loudness measured from real bytes.
composition.rendering: procedural synthesis (additive pluck/flute/bell/pad/bass + noise percussion), authored in build_composed_score_md8.py on the checkpoint-26 engine (build_composed_music.py) and the MD1 arrangement (build_composed_score_md1.py); no external samples

seam.method: mono 48kHz decode; head/tail = first/last 100 ms; wrap jump = |last sample - first sample|; indicator only, not a seamlessness PASS
seam.landingNote: wrapJump is measured after a 0.25 s end-landing blend to the first sample (loop crossfade construction); wrapJumpRaw is the step before it

combinedWithBase.method: base master + layer master summed from real bytes, ffmpeg loudnorm

notes: Phase layers are ADDITIVE loops at the parent cue's tempo/bars (-25 LUFS target): they play over the base cue, they do not replace it. Combined base+layer loudness/true-peak is measured from real bytes and recorded per layer.

The MD8 layer adds only what its base and the earlier layers do not already do: thanh_lac intensity adds the two-beat market drum pulse the busiest street arrangement withholds (no drums at all in the base) plus a low pluck echo on melody-free bars. After MD8 every composed score cue carries an intensity layer; no further intensity layer is pending for a score cue.
